executor_result.summary: Implement DefiLlama components live run_once context-only integration regression test suite as requested.

instructions: TEST ONLY. Create exactly part2/capital_flow/tests/test_defillama_components_live_context_integration.py; do not change production code, other tests, or any control file. At exact base SHA, runner._collect_live already registers DefiLlamaStablecoinCompositionCollector as 'defillama_stablecoin_components'. Its parse_payload() emits context-only FlowObservations, source 'defillama_stablecoin_components', family 'stablecoin', UTC-day-bucket effective_at_ms, available_at_ms/observed_at_ms/revision equal to collection as_of_ms. Add ONE deterministic focused runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=True,include_backfill=False,as_of_ms=1787520123456) integration test: monkeypatch runner.DefiLlamaStablecoinCompositionCollector with class whose collect(*,observed_at_ms) calls the REAL DefiLlamaStablecoinCompositionCollector.parse_payload(fixed in-memory payload,observed_at_ms=observed_at_ms,symbols=('USDT','USDC')); patch the other EIGHT default runner collectors to return [] with collect(**kwargs), no HTTP/network. Reuse the known-good fixture semantics from test_v1_handoff.py: peggedAssets USDT id '2' circulating peggedUSD=1000, previous day=900, week=800, month=700, price=1.0001; USDC id '1' circulating=500, previous day=525, week=510, no previous month, price=0.9999. Expect 9 context-only rows (USDT five metrics, USDC four), no scoring rows. Assert collection_attempts has defillama_stablecoin_components status OK observation_count 9; source_errors=[]; appended_observations=archive_records_loaded=9; scoring_records_loaded=0. Load result['paths']['archive'] via load_observations; verify 9 rows all context_only, source/family/asset/metric, effective UTC-day bucket=(as_of_ms//86400000)*86400000, available_at_ms=observed_at_ms=as_of_ms, revision=str(as_of_ms), and no synthetic missing 30d USDC metric. Assert result['anata_output']['stablecoin_context'] schema by checking actual build_anata_handoff key at this HEAD (inspect handoff.py first), known=true, tracked_component_count=2, tracked_supply_usd=1500, tracked_change_1d_usd=75, peg_price_coverage=1.0, change_coverage['30d']=0.5, USDC missing change_30d_usd. Verify anata_output['families']['stablecoin'] context_observation_count=9, scoring_observation_count=0, scoring_latest_available_at_ms is None, scoring_latest_effective_at_ms is None; source_evidence entry family stablecoin/source defillama_stablecoin_components role context with three clocks and revision provenance, no scoring source evidence from this collector. Verify anata_output['evidence_health']['collection']['successful_collectors'] contains defillama_stablecoin_components; evidence_health['families']['stablecoin'] visible_observation_count=9, scoring_observation_count=0, scoring_missing=true, scoring availability/effective age None. Verify audit_latest JSON 'context_only_observation_count'==9; DO NOT assert this key at anata_output top level (it does not exist). Add PIT guard runner.run_once(network=False,local_dir=same tmp_path,as_of_ms=1787520123455) and verify archive still loaded but family context_observation_count=0, source_evidence has no defillama components entry, stablecoin_context known=false; no scoring support. Do not expect archive_records_loaded or scoring_records_loaded to change due to PIT guard (scoring_records_loaded is zero because all archived rows are context only). Preserve frozen scoring, context-only/scoring isolation, scoring-only freshness, revision identity, source PIT and explicit missingness. Run the exact targeted and full pytest commands below; do not broaden scope. If schema differs, inspect actual HEAD and use only real keys, never invent output keys. Fail closed with concrete logs if tests fail.
